Design system and report

03

Why

The fulfillment manager needs to find the correct repeat buyer and transfer shipping details quickly without introducing mistakes. Planning the complete flow first exposed the exact buyer, address, pickup, courier, and feedback states the finished app must support.

The design system turns repeated choices into rules, reducing inconsistent styling when the wireframes become working components.

04

Blockers and problems

  • The first PDF exports had uneven button padding and crowded content; the shared alignment and card spacing were corrected.
  • The one-default-address and one-default-pickup rule is designed but not implemented or tested.
  • The hosted interface is still a planning prototype with placeholder records and no persistence.
05

What is left

  1. Build

    Create the React routes and reusable components from the approved wireframes.

  2. Connect

    Implement the Express REST API and PostgreSQL schema for buyers, couriers, addresses, and pickup locations.

  3. Protect

    Add validation, database constraints, transactions, and useful loading and error states.

  4. Prove

    Seed fictional records, test the main task flow, and complete setup, usage, endpoint, and screenshot documentation.
